title: Security: Cookie injection by Proxy with 407 response
description_snippet:
Chrome mistakenly accepts cookies in a 407 response of CONNECT request from proxy.  
  
**VERSION**   
Chrome Version: All  
Operating System: All  
  
**REPRODUCTION CASE**   
1. Set up a HTTP proxy in Chrome.
